version.approval_notes:
Lumenia makes a payment link from the user's own Lumenia account and shows whether it was claimed. The recipient opens the link on getlumenia.com and needs no extension.

HOW TO TEST (practice money, Stellar testnet, free, no account or email needed): 1) Open the add-on: "Get started", then "Agree and continue". 2) "No, I'm new here": pick a password of at least 10 characters, type it again, "Create my account"; practice dollars are added on their own. 3) "Make my first link": type 0.10, "Make the link", "Copy link"; open it in a private window and press "Take $0.10" there (no wallet needed). The link's row in Links turns Claimed. 4) Right-click any text box on any page and choose "Paste a Lumenia link here", then make a link: it is typed into that box (nothing is sent; the user presses Send). Optional: "Back it up" stores the account's backup (ciphertext) with an email address and a mailed code; "Yes, bring it here" restores it in another browser.

BUILD: the code is bundled with esbuild (not minified). The source zip rebuilds byte-identically: Node 24, pnpm 9.12.0 (corepack), pnpm install --frozen-lockfile at the repository root, then pnpm --filter @lumenia/extension build; the Firefox files are in apps/extension/dist/firefox. See apps/extension/README.md.

BASE64 IN THE BUNDLE: background.js contains (a) the WebAssembly modules of hash-wasm 4.12.0 (MIT, unmodified, npm), which this library ships as base64 strings in its own JavaScript; it computes Argon2id, used only to derive the key that encrypts the user's account key from their password, and (b) the Stellar SDK's own contract spec data (XDR) from @stellar/stellar-sdk 16.3.0. Neither is obfuscation; both can be compared with the npm tarballs. 'wasm-unsafe-eval' in the CSP is for (a) only.

NETWORK: only the six hosts in host_permissions (Lumenia's two sponsor servers, Stellar Horizon and RPC on testnet and mainnet), also enforced by connect-src in the CSP (script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' plus the six; img-src 'self'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'). No remote code: the build fails on eval(, Function(, string timers, importScripts(, dynamic import( and HTML assigned from a string. Real money (mainnet) is an invite-only pilot: it is refused unless Lumenia's server has approved the account, and capped at 5 dollars a link and 50 a day.

LINT: web-ext lint reports 0 errors and 1 warning, UNSAFE_VAR_ASSIGNMENT (innerHTML) in popup.js. It is inside Preact 10.29.8's own published file, in the branch for dangerouslySetInnerHTML; no source here passes dangerouslySetInnerHTML (the build fails on that word under src/), so the branch never runs.

DEPENDENCY AUDIT: pnpm audit lists axios 1.18.0 and smol-toml 1.6.1 under @stellar/stellar-sdk 16.3.0; neither is in the package (the SDK's browser build uses feaxios in place of axios, and the TOML parser is not reached).

DATA COLLECTION: required personallyIdentifyingInfo (the email for the one-time code), authenticationInfo (the code and the encrypted key record) and financialAndPaymentInfo (the signed transfers); optional technicalAndInteraction, which gates the usage counters (an event name, two 8-byte SHA-256 hashes and the marker ext): with it withheld, no counter is sent.

PRIVACY: https://getlumenia.com/privacy (section The browser extension).
